verdict.rationale: GitBook publishes a GitBook API reference describing a RESTful API with GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE methods. Agent-oriented surfaces sit alongside it: an official MCP server that can create sites, open change requests and edit pages, and a CLI for inspecting spaces and pages, so the product can be driven programmatically. The API evidence is a single thin snippet, and probes did not find a published OpenAPI spec at standard paths. Missing for 10: detail on API coverage, authentication and rate limits, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
